summary: SPY +0.3% pre-market as oil gives back part of Friday's Houthi-attack spike; FOMC and MSFT/GOOGL earnings on Wednesday, no open-to-close edge today (p_up 0.53). Sniper: TSLA call on the Barclays upgrade to Overweight (PT $370 -> $450), gap +2.5%.

Oil retreats after Friday's spike on Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia: USO -2.2% pre-market after +4.3% Friday (52-week high); WTI ~$101, Brent ~$114.5 (CNBC). XLE -1.2%. TLT +0.3%, UUP +0.1%: yields slightly lower, dollar flat. 2Y/10Y bp changes, VIX and DXY level not found this morning

Last week: S&P lowest since 10-01, Nasdaq 100 -7.5% from its high, Fear & Greed 'extreme fear' on Thursday. A gap-up Monday before a heavy event week: the gap is priced at the open (OVERNIGHT.md), so no call

META announced common-stock and depositary-share offerings pre-market, with NVDA, AMD and AVGO each indicating interest in up to $5B (Benzinga 07:17); META traded 610-662 pre-market, now -0.7%. Equity raise to fund AI capex: capex headlines cut both ways, no pick on META or its cornerstone buyers (AMD +1.2%, NVDA +1.0%, AVGO +1.0%)
Anthropic S-1 due at 09:00 ET (AMZN and GOOGL hold stakes): unknown content, GOOGL reports Wednesday, not a sniper
AAPL -1.2% pre-market with no company headline found (iPhone Duo sold out, MacBook launch Wednesday, reports 11-02): no pick
No >= 2% pre-market down gap among the rebound_scanner large caps

Dossiers: META small gaps (within 1%) mostly fill, big gaps continue; META news also moves the CPU chain (today AMD is a cornerstone buyer of META's offering). AMD up gaps >= 2% continue but calls bought at 09:45 lost; today's AMD gap is +1.2%

Sniper TSLA: Barclays (Dan Levy) upgraded Equal Weight -> Overweight, PT $370 -> $450, citing the SpaceX combination as part of the bull case, energy storage nearly sold out for 2027 and a recovering auto business (Benzinga 06:31; MarketScreener/Investing.com). Mizuho PT $460. Also FSD (Supervised) approved in Latvia. Pre-market 381.41 vs 372.22 close (+2.5%, inside the ~3% bar for a heavy catalyst); Webull median target 425. TSLA 1-week +4.9% while the market fell. Against it: ANALYST.md shows TSLA rating changes have not carried (12 events, open->close median -0.5%, 50% up); an independent analyst's note (08:47) says Q3 free cash flow was flattered by $1.9B of stretched supplier payments; TSLA reported 10-21 (not today or tomorrow)
